ports.note: Takes the chosen product, and optionally a study area whose extent is searched; with no area connected, the extent is four edges typed in the dialog. Emits satellite-files: remote files not yet read, its own port type so nothing mistakes addresses for data.

ontology.note: The receipt states the catalog, collection, product, extent and where it came from (a study area or a typed extent), dates, how many items were returned, matched and kept, whether the search stopped at its limit, and fw:completenessRead false: a search reads no pixels. Held by fw:SatelliteCatalogSearchShape.

changes.description: A search longer than a month is made a month at a time and each item kept once; a failed request is tried twice more. The standard Inspector, held in satellite-catalog-ui.ts, not app.ts.

evidence.note: The search builder, its messages and the 500-item bound are JLT's, ported. Unit tests use a stubbed catalog; a live search was run against Planetary Computer in a browser. Nothing here reads a file, so nothing establishes that an item holds usable pixels over the area. 0.5.0: tests/satellite-catalog.test.mjs (month windows, an item in two windows kept once, retries and no retry on 4xx); measured live 2026-11-19, the year over Rio de Janeiro state: 180 items, 12 requests, 5.0 s, where the paged search failed on its second page; tests/search-satellite-catalog.browser.mjs and tests/sample-satellite-files.browser.mjs, Chromium and WebKit.
